第673章 沧源 我骂我自己（第1页）
帝凰的声音带着难以置信的茫然：“气息……气息也是有相似之处？难道他们本来就是同一个存在？“
青帝喃喃道：“传闻在最初，这位苍帝便在找某样东西，疑似证大道境的契机，所以他走遍了数个无量大界，葬掉了数个无量大界，但都没有找到。
难道……苍帝要找的，也是无瑕道心？“
葬帝星的阴阳二气停滞了整整三息，他的声音中带着一种复杂的了然：“能让苍帝这种存在疯狂的，恐怕就只有证大道境之物了。“
始帝最直接：“所以沧源是内鬼？是他把黑潮引来的？！“
祂的目光从始至终都只落在一个方向——沧源。
那双赤红色的瞳孔中带着跨越了无尽岁月、穿越了无数维度的复杂情绪，如同一个寻找了自己另一半无尽岁月的旅人，终于在终点处看到了那个等候已久的身影。
苍帝开口，声音平淡却带着一种说不清道不明的深意：“我们终于是见面了。“
沧源从盘古身后踏出一步，立于无乡域之上，面对苍帝那双赤红色的眼眸，语气不惊不躁：“是啊。“
同源而出，却又走在完全不同的道路上。
苍帝的赤红色瞳孔中翻涌着难以抑制的狂喜。
如同一头饿极了的猛兽终于看到了盘中美餐。
祂向前迈出一步，黑潮在祂脚下翻涌成一条暗红色的长毯，延伸向无乡域的方向。
祂的面容因为过于激动而微微扭曲：“你我本为一体，如今相见，合该重归一体——“
“展现出你我大罗天的无上神威，让一切匍匐在我们脚下！“
沧源站在原地，神色复杂地看着眼前这张与自己一模一样的脸。
沧源歪了歪头，语气随意得像是在跟老朋友聊天：“重归一体后，你我谁是主导？“

苍帝不假思索：“当然是我们完整的意志。“
沧源嗤笑一声，摇了摇头：“很好的主意。“
“但你这面相。“他上下打量了苍帝一眼，眼神中带着一种意味深长的嫌弃：“我很难信服啊。“
那张与沧源一模一样的面容上，狂喜的表情僵硬了整整三息，随即化作一种复杂的无语凝噎。
沧源摊手：“不不不，你是你，我是我，咱俩顶多算个复制粘贴，但粘贴的时候出了点bug。“
“你看看你那发色，白的，看看你那眼睛，红的，再看看你那衣服黑不溜秋的带点红，跟刚从煤窑里爬出来似的。“
“我一身苍蓝道袍清清爽爽，你一身黑红搭配鬼鬼祟祟。你说咱俩同源，谁信啊？“
沧源继续补刀：“而且你那个眉心纹，黑的，跟我这个苍蓝色的大道神纹一比，高下立判好吧？“
“咱就是说，哪怕你真要当反派，能不能稍微注意一下穿搭？“
苍帝嘴角抽了抽，终于憋出一句话：“你废话怎么这么多？“
沧源耸肩：“彼此彼此，你一见面就喊着合体合体的，又比我好到哪去？“
苍帝深吸一口气，赤红色的瞳孔中那抹狂喜已经彻底被一种“我为什么要跟这个家伙废话“的无奈取代。
沧源见好就收，向后一退，缩回了盘古那道伟岸的身影之后。
“有什么话跟这位爷说吧。“沧源从盘古身后探出半个脑袋，朝苍帝努了努嘴。
苍帝看着盘古那尊横亘在无乡域之前的身影，嘴角微微抽动了一下。
盘古虚影提着开天神斧，居高临下地看着苍帝，语气平淡却带着一种不容置疑的压迫感：“想抓这小子，先过了吾这关再说。“

Chapter 673 Cangyuan I scold myself (page 1)
Emperor Huang's voice was filled with disbelief: "The aura...the aura is also similar? Are they originally the same existence?"
Qing Emperor murmured: "It was rumored that the Cang Emperor was looking for something at the beginning, which seemed to be an opportunity to prove the Great Dao Realm, so he traveled to several immeasurable realms and buried several immeasurable realms, but he couldn't find any.
Could it be that... what Cang Emperor is looking for is also the flawless Taoist heart? "
The yin and yang energy of the Emperor Burial Star stagnated for three full breaths, and there was a complex understanding in his voice: "The only thing that can make a being like Cang Emperor go crazy is to achieve the Great Dao Realm."
The First Emperor was the most direct: "So Cangyuan is the traitor? It was he who attracted the Black Tide?!"
His eyes only fell in one direction from beginning to end - Cangyuan.
Those crimson pupils carried complex emotions that spanned endless years and traveled through countless dimensions, like a traveler who had been searching for his other half for endless years and finally saw the long-awaited figure at the end.
Emperor Cang spoke, his voice calm but with an unexplainable meaning: "We finally meet."
Cangyuan took a step from behind Pangu and stood on the Wuxiang Realm. Facing Emperor Cang's red eyes, his tone was calm and calm: "Yes."
They come from the same origin, but are on completely different paths.
Cang Emperor's crimson pupils were filled with uncontrollable ecstasy.
Like a very hungry beast finally seeing a delicious meal on the plate.
He took a step forward, and the black tide surged under his feet into a long dark red carpet, extending in the direction of the No Country.
His face was slightly distorted due to excessive excitement: "You and I were originally one, and now that we meet, we should become one again -"
"Show the supreme power of you and me, Da Luotian, and let everything crawl under our feet!"
Cangyuan stood there, looking at the face in front of him that was exactly the same as his with a complicated expression.
Cangyuan tilted his head, and his tone was as casual as if he was chatting with an old friend: "After we are reunited, who will be the leader between you and me?"
Emperor Cang said without hesitation: "Of course it is our complete will."
Cangyuan sneered and shook his head: "It's a very good idea."
"But your appearance." He looked Cang Emperor up and down, with a meaningful disgust in his eyes: "It's hard for me to believe you."
On the face that was exactly the same as Cangyuan's, the expression of ecstasy froze for three breaths, and then turned into a complicated and speechless expression.
Cangyuan spread his hands: "No, no, no, you are you and I am me. The best we can do is copy and paste, but there was a bug when we pasted."
"Look at your hair color, it's white, look at your eyes, they're red, and look at your clothes, which are dark and slightly red, as if you just climbed out of a coal mine."
"I'm wearing a light blue Taoist robe, and you're wearing a black and red outfit that's sneaky. You say we have the same origin, who would believe it?"
Cangyuan continued to touch up: "And your eyebrow lines are black. Compare them with my pale blue avenue divine lines. Let's judge the difference, okay?"
"What I'm saying is, even if you really want to be a villain, can you pay a little more attention to your outfit?"
The corners of Emperor Cang's mouth twitched, and he finally choked out a sentence: "Why do you talk so much nonsense?"
Cangyuan shrugged: "Both and each other, you shout "fit and fit" as soon as we meet, how are you better than me?"
Emperor Cang took a deep breath, and the ecstasy in his red pupils was completely replaced by the helplessness of "Why should I talk nonsense to this guy?"
Cangyuan retreated when he saw the situation, stepped back, and retracted Pangu's majestic figure.after.
"If you have anything to say, tell this man." Cangyuan poked half of his head out from behind Pangu and pursed his lips toward Cang Emperor.
Emperor Cang looked at the figure of Pangu standing in front of the Wuxiang Realm, and the corner of his mouth twitched slightly.
Pangu Xuying held the God-Opening Ax and looked down at Cang Emperor. His tone was calm but with an unquestionable sense of oppression: "If you want to catch this kid, you must first pass my level."
